_comment: LAB 'Kalman filter': the simulator side of launch/kalman.launch.py gps:=open (the default).
world open          30 x 20 m of empty floor: a field, nothing to hit
spawns              the start of the loop in ohm_kalman_localization/route.py, heading 0
gps                 five fixes per second, sigma 0.5 m on x and y, no bias
odom.geometry       the odometry believes the robot 3 % faster than it is (scale_xy 1.03)
debug_truth         /<robot>/truth for the driver and the monitor, never for your filter
gui_rate 10         the window draws 10 frames per second: old laptops
